title: Answer
description:
A priest is taken from among men, appointed by God, and stands for men in things toward God. That is the older pattern, and it is already aimed at the Son.

The earlier priest offered first for his own sins, because he shared the people’s weakness. A priest with no sin of His own does not offer for Himself.

No man takes this honor to himself. Men who seized it were judged. The Son does not seize the office.
